name: Client document
trigger: sizing, FDD plan, status report or meeting material asked for

steps.name: Draft in work/
steps.means: The client agent writes the document in work/ (never Markdown).

sla.why: refit to p75 of 7 observed stays (2026-11-15; Ben 2026-11-15)

steps.name: Review
steps.means: A fresh agent checks it against its checklist, for up to two rounds.

steps.name: Promote
steps.means: The board copies the approved file to deliverables; if it refuses, Ben clicks Promote.
steps.gate: auto-promoted when the dod_review approves (auto_promote switch); Ben's click on /deliverables if refused

steps.name: Covering email
steps.means: The client agent drafts the email that sends the promoted copy; nothing is sent.

steps.name: Send
steps.means: Ben sends the email; that closes the case.
